snippet.title: MAESTRO: "ATTACK ON TITAN" DLC!
snippet.description:
Attack on Titan: Now Available in Maestro! 🪽

A new DLC featuring:

- "Attack on Titan" by Hiroyuki Sawano
- "Ashes on The Fire" by Kohta Yamamoto
-  A new baton: The Titan Sweeper! 🪶

Sasageyo, Maestro! ⚔️

https://www.meta.com/en-us/experiences/lattaque-des-titans/964688763249618/

Take command of a massive orchestra as the walls tremble and humanity’s fate hangs in the balance!

Lead your orchestra through two iconic masterpieces from japanese animation masterpiece Attack on Titan. From its haunting melodies to its most raging moments, feel the tension rise and unleash the full force of the orchestra as you conduct two epic anthems that have become legendary among anime fans!

This new DLC is also available on SteamVR, PSVR2 and Pico! 

Quick reminder:  Maestro is coming to Nintendo Switch 1 & 2 on September, 17!

https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/maestro-switch-2/

Join us on Discord to see the full patchnote! 

👉 https://discord.gg/sqped4 👈

#AoT #AttackOnTitan #AshesOnFires  #Maestro #Gaming #RhythmGame​ #VR
